categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Shuanglin Auto Parts Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive parts manufacturing, including automotive interior and exterior components, precision parts, intelligent control system components, new energy power systems, wheel hub bearings, planetary roller screws, and ball screws. The company also develops products for humanoid robots and low-altitude economic sectors such as vehicle-mounted drones and aircraft electric drive systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as precision gear and screw manufacturing, electric motor and control system design, oil-cooled flat wire technology for hybrid platforms, and high-precision grinding technology acquired through strategic acquisition. It employs platform-based design for electric drive systems and has developed proprietary technologies in planetary roller screws for humanoid robots, electric headrest actuators, and automatic steering wheel folding actuators. Production methods include stamping, rolling, injection molding, machining, painting, and assembly, supported by SAP-based production planning and lean manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international OEMs and first-tier suppliers such as BYD, Changan, XPeng, Li Auto, Great Wall, SAIC, FAW, NIO, and global suppliers like Freudenberg, Lear, Adient, and Autoliv. The company serves the automotive industry with a focus on new energy vehicles and intelligent mobility, and is expanding into humanoid robotics and low-altitude aerial vehicle markets. Its products are used in passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and emerging intelligent robotic applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production and R&D bases in Ningbo, Shanghai, Chongqing, Suzhou, Qingdao, Tianjin, Wuhan, and other cities. It has established overseas subsidiaries and manufacturing facilities in Thailand, Singapore, Australia, and the United States, serving markets in Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe. The global footprint supports local OEMs and international customers, enhancing supply chain responsiveness and market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Shuanglin operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of automotive components and modules. It integrates upstream activities through strategic acquisitions in precision grinding equipment manufacturing, enabling vertical integration. The company supplies directly to OEMs and first-tier suppliers, positioning itself as a critical component supplier in the automotive and emerging robotics industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation focusing on core automotive components such as seat drive systems, electric drive platforms for new energy vehicles, and advanced bearing units. It is actively developing humanoid robot components including planetary roller screws and joint modules, and expanding into low-altitude economy products like vehicle-mounted drone clamps and aircraft electric drives. Digital transformation, AI-enabled quality prediction, and global market expansion, especially in Southeast Asia and North America, are strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive parts and components to OEMs and first-tier suppliers. The company follows a make-to-order production model with sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from strategic investments, government subsidies, and occasional asset disposals. The business model is product-centric with a focus on volume sales and long-term supply contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Shuanglin is a leading domestic player in automotive seat drive systems and wheel hub bearings, competing with both domestic and international suppliers. It holds a strong market position with significant scale and technological advantages in China’s largest automotive market. The company is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and industry leader, with competitive strengths in product quality, cost control, and innovation, positioning it well against peers in the automotive components and emerging robotics sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.91 billion, an 18.64% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 497 million, a 514.49% increase. The company’s asset base totaled over RMB 6.27 billion with steady growth in net assets. It maintains strong cash flow generation and has expanded production capacity, especially in new energy components, reflecting a robust growth trajectory aligned with industry trends.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Shuanglin emphasizes technological innovation, product reliability, and cost efficiency as its core value propositions. Its products feature high precision, long service life, low noise, and energy efficiency, meeting stringent requirements of new energy and intelligent vehicles. The company’s integration of upstream manufacturing capabilities and global localized production enhances supply chain agility and customer responsiveness. Its pioneering developments in humanoid robot components and low-altitude economy products differentiate it as a forward-looking supplier in emerging high-tech markets.
